cache_rules.name: Bypass Cache for API Endpoints
cache_rules.description: Ensure dynamic API endpoints and authenticated REST queries bypass Cloudflare edge cache

cache_rules.name: Bypass Cache for Private Application Routes
cache_rules.description: Bypass cache for authenticated SPA application routes and session-dependent views

cache_rules.name: Bypass Cache for Staging Host
cache_rules.description: Ensure all staging environment traffic bypasses edge cache for immediate validation

cache_rules.name: Bypass Cache on Authorization Header or Session Cookie
cache_rules.description: Bypass cache when requests carry authentication tokens or session state
cache_rules.expression: (http.request.headers["authorization"] ne "") or (http.request.cookies["lifeos_session"] ne "") or (http.request.cookies["lifeos_staging_session"] ne "") or (http.request.cookies["JSESSIONID"] ne "")

cache_rules.name: Cache Static SPA Assets
cache_rules.description: Cache content-hashed frontend bundles and assets at edge for performance

rate_limiting_rules.name: Auth Endpoint Rate Limiting
rate_limiting_rules.description: Restrict authentication endpoint abuse to 10 requests per minute per IP

rate_limiting_rules.name: General API Rate Limiting
rate_limiting_rules.description: Restrict rapid API scraping attempts to 120 requests per minute per IP
